_doc: Frozen power standard for DAX W1. See dax/memo/PI_DECISION_D3_2026-08-18.md. This file is the ONLY source of the pass bar. Nothing may recompute it from the analysis sample; freeze_power_standard.py fills it once from the frozen pre-event CPS extract and refuses to overwrite without --force.

frozen_window.rationale: Ends the month before the first eligible event (GPT4_LAUNCH, 2023-03), so the constant cannot contain any post-treatment information.

benchmark.quantity: relative decline in EMPLOYMENT (headcount), not payroll
benchmark.measured_in: ADP administrative payroll data — 'payroll' names the DATA SOURCE, not the outcome variable. This distinction is what M2 flagged.
benchmark.population: workers ages 22-25 in the most AI-exposed occupations
benchmark.citation: Brynjolfsson, E., B. Chandar, and R. Chen. 2025. "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence." Working paper.
locators: docs/DAX_ERE_Proposal_v3.md:12 (the claim, in the project's own proposal)
benchmark.version_note: The figure has drifted across versions of the SAME paper: 0.13 in the version the proposal cites, reportedly 0.16 in a later revision, and reportedly 0.19 in the August 2026 version using ADP data through June 2026. The 0.16 and 0.19 figures come from web-search summaries only; the PDFs are egress-blocked here and were NOT read. Freezing is one-way, and the choice moves the pass bar in the direction that makes the design easier to pass, so it is a PI decision.

forbidden: recomputing after the event set, mapping, dose definition, window rule or sample changes
